description: Thomas St Overpass Bicycle & Pedestrian Counter is a dataset listed in City of Seattle open data portal (cos-data.seattle.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Seattle. Counter is located at the bridge entrance of the Thomas St Overpass. These sensors counts both people riding bikes and pedestrians. Separate volumes are tallied for each travel mode. Wires in a diamond formation in the concrete detect bikes and an infrared sensor mounted on a metal post that detects pedestrians. Coverage: Seattle. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are bicycle, pedestrian, monthly data, bike counts, seattle. The table has 6 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-10 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-cos-data-seattle-gov-portal.
